title: 第15章 冲突第16章 学习会
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
课上，安德烈教授通过列举各种生动有趣的例子，成功地让同学们深刻理解了数学在召唤术领域中的重要作用和广泛应用。
就在大家沉浸其中时，一节课的时间悄然流逝，临近下课。
安德烈教授轻咳一声，引起同学们的注意后，宣布道：“同学们，今天的课后作业是一个经典的数学问题——‘食人魔问题’。
但这次有个小小的要求，希望你们能给出至少三种以上的解题方法。
同时，我允许你们以四人以下的小组形式进行合作讨论。
下节课，我们将邀请同学们上台展示自己的解答方案。
对于提供解法最多的同学，其所在的小组内每个人都将获得2学分的奖励。”
听到这里，同学们纷纷议论起来。
“这到底是怎样的问题呢？”
法伦低声嘀咕着，心里暗自琢磨。
他觉得这个所谓的“食人魔问题”
可能是某个经典数学问题在异世界的变种，但具体究竟是什么，他一时半会儿也摸不着头脑，因为他也不知道这个世界的食人魔长什么样。
下课铃声响起，安德烈教授拿起自己的课本便离开了教室。
随着安德烈教授的身影消失在门外，教室里的气氛突然变得有些紧张。
贵族学生们开始三三两两地聚集在一起，小声讨论着课后作业的问题，而平民学生则大多显得有些无助，不知道如何是好。
法伦注意到，那个叫韦斯特的贵族学生，他有着一头淡金色的头发和高傲的眼神，但今天，他在课堂上的沉默让他显得有些不自在，而法伦的表现又是那么的惹人注目。
法伦的表现显然触动了他的自尊心，韦斯特的脸上写满了不甘心。
韦斯特站起身，向法伦走了过来，他的声音中带着明显的挑衅：“法伦，你只是个平民，有什么资格在课堂上出风头？你难道不知道自己的身份吗？"
面对如此降智又直白的挑衅，法伦差点忍不住回敬一句"
你白痴吧！

但多年的网络对线经验告诉他，谁先骂脏话，谁就是最先破防的那个人。
韦斯特的发难吸引来了课室绝大多数同学的目光，特别是同样是平民出身的其他学生。
看到不少平民学生的注意被吸引过来，法伦眼珠子一转，似乎想到了什么好事，嘿嘿一笑地回击道：“那你为什么不表现呢？是不想吗？”
法伦的嘲讽无异于火上浇油，韦斯特脸色变得铁青，不屑地说：“你这个东流蛮子！
你凭什么这样跟我说话！”
法伦露出了像是看到什么珍稀动物的神情，手指着韦斯特，对旁边的人说：“他急了。”
韦斯特从小到大哪里受过这种屈辱，挽起袖子上前，就想给这瘦弱的东流蛮子一点颜色瞧瞧。
看到韦斯特要上前干架，法伦也有点慌，心里不断咒骂道：“什么破贵族，一急就要动手吗！
？自己这小身板怕是一拳都挨不住！”
咻的一声，一道红色的光芒划过，紧接着，一柄赤红刀柄、金黄色刀镡、漆黑刀身的武士刀直直地插入韦斯特身前不到半米的地方，发出清脆的声音，地面上甚至出现了一道裂缝。
这突如其来的变故让韦斯特不禁停下了脚步，眼神中流露出一丝惊讶和恐惧。
content_en:
In class, Professor Andre successfully gave students a deep understanding of the important role and widespread application of mathematics in the field of summoning by citing various vivid and interesting examples.
Just as everyone was immersed in it, the time of a class passed quietly, and the end of get out of class was approaching.
Professor Andre coughed lightly, attracting the attention of the students, and announced: "Students, today's homework is a classic mathematics problem - the 'Ogre Problem'.
But this time I have a small request. I hope you can give at least three ways to solve the problem.
At the same time, I allow you to conduct collaborative discussions in groups of less than four people.
In the next class, we will invite students to come on stage to present their solutions.
For the student who provides the most solutions, everyone in his or her group will receive a reward of 2 credits. "
After hearing this, the students started talking one after another.
"What kind of problem is this?"
Fallon muttered under his breath, thinking to himself.
He feels that this so-called "ogre problem"
It might be a variation of a certain classic mathematical problem in another world, but he couldn't figure out what it was for a while, because he didn't know what the ogres in this world looked like.
When the bell rang, Professor Andre picked up his textbook and left the classroom.
As Professor Andre disappeared outside the door, the atmosphere in the classroom suddenly became a little tense.
The aristocratic students began to gather together in twos and threes, discussing homework in low voices, while most of the civilian students seemed a little helpless and didn't know what to do.
Fallon noticed that the aristocratic student named West had light blond hair and arrogant eyes, but today, his silence in class made him look a little uncomfortable, and Fallon's performance was so eye-catching.
Fallon's performance obviously touched his pride, and West's face was full of reluctance.
West stood up and walked towards Fallon, with obvious provocation in his voice: "Fallon, you are just a civilian, what qualifications do you have to be prominent in class? Don't you know your identity?"
Faced with such a clever and straightforward provocation, Fallon almost couldn't help but retaliate: "
You idiot!
But many years of online experience told him that whoever curses first will be the first to break the defense.
West's attack attracted the attention of most students in the classroom, especially other students who were also from civilian backgrounds.
Seeing that the attention of many civilian students was attracted, Fallon rolled his eyes, as if he thought of something good, and replied with a smile: "Then why don't you show off? Don't you want to? "
Fallon's taunting only added fuel to the fire. West's face turned livid and he said disdainfully: "You bastard!
Why are you talking to me like this! "
Fallon showed an expression as if he had seen some rare animal, pointed at West, and said to the person next to him: "He is anxious. "
West had never experienced this kind of humiliation since he was a child. He rolled up his sleeves and stepped forward, just to show off some color to this thin Eastern barbarian.
Seeing that West was about to come forward to fight, Fallon was also a little panicked, and kept cursing in his heart: "What a bastard noble, do you want to take action in a hurry?
? I'm afraid I can't withstand a punch with my small body! "
With a hiss, a red light flashed across, and then, a samurai sword with a red handle, a golden tan, and a black blade was inserted straight into a place less than half a meter in front of West. It made a crisp sound, and a crack even appeared on the ground.
This sudden change made West stop in his tracks, with a trace of surprise and fear in his eyes.
